name: ModelBuild
lead: What `models.new` hands its build function: makes the model's materials, textures, parts and animations.

functions.name: material
functions.signature: modelBuild:material(name: string, color: Ink, opts: { grain: number ?, alpha: number ? }?) → ModelMaterial
functions.description: Makes a named colour a display may repaint; `grain` (0 to 1) darkens pixels into four tones, `alpha` below 1 is glass.

functions.name: texture
functions.signature: modelBuild:texture(width: number, height: number, opts: { tint: ModelMaterial ?, scroll: ("up" | "down" | "left" | "right")?, speed: number ? }?) → ModelTexture
functions.description: Makes a pixel picture for one face; with `tint`, drawn in greys and coloured by that material. With `scroll`, it moves by itself on a block drawn from the model, `speed` texels a tick (1, 2, 3, or 0.5, 0.25).

functions.name: part
functions.signature: modelBuild:part(name: string, opts: { pivot: Vec3 ? }?) → ModelPart
functions.description: Makes a named child part of the root that turns around its `pivot`, the model's origin unless given.

functions.name: animation
functions.description: `{ length = seconds, loop = false, <part name> = { rotation = { [t] = is both named fields and part names, so this one is open.
